title: Kale and potato hash with eggs

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Potatoes, onion, garlic, kale, eggs, cheddar, oil and spices are all plain home staples.

supermarket.reason: Every ingredient is an everyday item at any mainstream UK supermarket.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a large frying pan with a lid, a knife, a board and a grater, and uses simple frying.

works.reason: 600g potatoes, 150g kale and four eggs make a sensible breakfast for four, and 15 minutes covered plus 10 uncovered will cook small cubes through and brown them.

honest_times.reason: Twenty minutes covers cubing the potatoes, slicing the onion and garlic, shredding the kale and grating the cheese, and the steps add up to about 30 minutes of cooking.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed item is used and nothing unlisted appears, though step 2 should say 'smoked paprika' to match the list.

seasonal_feel.reason: A warm kale hash suits a cold late-October morning, and the kale is a main component rather than a garnish.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are short, clear British English that a neighbour could follow.

hearty_healthy.reason: Potatoes, greens, eggs and cheese make a filling, balanced breakfast a family would happily repeat.
